start: A gym member on the Workout tab, no workout open

user_sees: Live workout screen with a running clock, 'Add your first exercise', 'Add exercise', 'Discard workout' link and a greyed 'Log a set to finish'
must_not: A clock that starts at a wrong time
A second workout opened by a double tap

steps.action: Tap 'Add exercise', tick two exercises, tap 'Add 2'
user_sees: Back on the workout with the two exercises

steps.action: Type weight and reps, tick a set
user_sees: The set ticked, a rest timer starts; a new best pops up at the top
must_not: A best shown when it is not one

steps.action: Tap 'Finish workout', confirm on the sheet
user_sees: 'Workout complete' - 'Saved to your history.' with a kg-lifted headline card and one line (time · sets · kg lifted · records)
must_not: The workout saved twice from a double tap
An emptied workout ('0m 00s') flashing on the way out

user_sees: The Workout tab, no workout open
must_not: The live workout bar still showing

start: A gym member logging a workout from a routine

steps.action: Start a routine, change a set count, finish
user_sees: Summary, then 'Update "<routine>"?' with 'Update routine' and 'Keep original'
must_not: The question on an easy week

user_sees: '"<routine>" is updated for next time.'
The routine unchanged

start: A gym member in a live workout

user_sees: 'Swap exercise' - 'Instead of <name>, for this workout only' with 'Swap to' buttons
must_not: Create offered in the swap picker

user_sees: Back on the workout with the new exercise in that place
must_not: Two swaps from a double tap

steps.action: Tap the minimise button ('Minimise workout. It keeps running.')
user_sees: The tabs with a workout bar above them; the clock still runs
The same live workout with every set

start: A gym member on the finish summary

steps.action: Tap 'Add photo', pick Camera or Gallery
user_sees: The photo on the summary (up to 4)
must_not: A photo kept for a workout that was deleted ('This workout was deleted, so the photo wasn't added.')

user_sees: The share sheet or the phone's share menu
Profile with this workout at the top
must_not: The workout missing from the feed

start: A gym member in a live workout with no ticked sets, or when saving fails

steps.action: Look at the main button with no ticked set
user_sees: Greyed 'Log a set to finish'
'Could not save' - 'Something went wrong saving your workout. Your sets are still here — tap Finish to try again.'
must_not: A summary shown for a failed save

steps.action: Finish with every set unticked on the sheet
user_sees: 'Nothing to save' - 'Tick at least one set before finishing.'

steps.action: Add exercises when the add fails
user_sees: An error line in the picker, the list still works

steps.action: Open the summary for a workout that cannot be read
user_sees: 'Summary unavailable' and 'Done'

start: A gym member in a live workout with ticked sets

user_sees: 'Discard workout?' - 'This workout and its sets will be deleted. This cannot be undone.' with 'Discard' and 'Keep logging'
The same workout, every set still there
The Workout tab, no workout bar

steps.action: Edit a saved workout, press the phone's back
user_sees: 'Discard changes?' - 'Your edits will be thrown away. The saved workout stays as it was.' with 'Keep editing'
must_not: The edit left open as a workout in progress

steps.action: Save an edit of a workout that was deleted elsewhere
user_sees: 'Workout deleted' - 'This workout was deleted, so your changes were discarded.'
must_not: A crash or an editor that can only fail

start: A gym member who joined a gym in the app, coach notes switched on

user_sees: The summary with a facts line; a richer coach note only if the coach switch is on
must_not: Workout sent to an AI with the coach switch off
Health Connect data sent to the gym or an AI

steps.action: Look at what the gym can see after the workout
user_sees: Only what 'What my gym can see' lists
must_not: Body weight, photos or notes reaching the gym
